title: An option gate reads requires_min, and an absent threshold is 0
why: Two shapes the importer itself emits. `requires_min` is the name it writes (`min` is the hand-authored spelling), and it left the browser player hiding options the app showed; an absent threshold defaulted to 1 there instead of 0, hiding a third. A gate that differs between runtimes means the SAME save reaches a menu with different options in it.
